title: ever CABARET|Sequin Drop Shoulder Sleeve Beaded Formal Dress
descriptionHtml:
This 1920s-inspired evening gown captures vintage allure with intricate beaded sequins and a soft mesh overlay. The elegant V-neck and cap sleeves flatter the neckline and shoulders, while the fitted silhouette highlights your curves beautifully. Ideal for Great Gatsby parties, formal dinners, or evening galas where timeless elegance shines.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretchy.
